create_dogmatic_dict: create a DogmaticDict with fixed config keys that ignore attempts to overwrite them
create_dogmatic_list: create a DogmaticList that silently ignores all mutation operations like append or insert
create_readonly_dict: create a ReadOnlyDict that raises SacredError on any attempt to modify the dictionary
create_readonly_list: create a ReadOnlyList that raises SacredError on any attempt to modify the list
make_read_only: make a nested structure of dicts and lists read-only by converting to ReadOnlyDict and ReadOnlyList
